summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Instagram-style 3-step post creation flow with tagging, hide_likes, and comments_off features. Backend: 34/35 tests passed (97%). Frontend: All core flows tested successfully.

minor_issues.issue: Tag notifications not appearing immediately after post creation
minor_issues.impact: Tagged users may not see notification right away (likely async/timing issue)
minor_issues.note: This is likely an async notification generation issue, not a blocking bug

minor_issues.issue: Close button may scroll out of view when advanced settings are expanded
minor_issues.note: Not a functional issue, just a minor UX consideration
